case8_nondeterminism: Case 8 ('deprecated system properties converted to modern properties') asserts that solr.log contains the disable.config.edit conversion line immediately after start. At this byte-identical tree it passed in both positive variants of the prior gate (2026-11-13 evening) and failed in both positive variants today (two clean runs), as well as in the prior gate's mutated run. The failure snapshot shows the conversion line absent from solr.log at assertion time while conversions of other legacy properties were logged. The case is unrelated to the shutdown-order change (the repack tree is identical to the previously gated tree) and its outcome varies run to run on this host; it is disclosed here rather than counted against the gate's stated requirements (order assertion, no forced kill, both processes stopped), which were met in every clean run.
